sharing.q: Is my data shared with anyone?
sharing.a: Only with the Chartered Accountant you connect with, and only the parts you choose. You can revoke their access at any time. We do not sell your data.

needCa.q: Do I need an accountant to use Accentra?
needCa.a: No. You can record transactions and keep documents on your own. Connecting a CA is optional.

replaceCa.q: Is Accentra a replacement for my CA?
replaceCa.a: No. Accentra helps you and your CA work together. Professional advice, audits and filings remain your CA's work.

gst.q: Does Accentra file my GST returns?
gst.a: No, not currently. GST summaries are planned to help you and your CA prepare returns, but filing is done by you or your CA on the GST portal.

caNotOnAccentra.q: What if my CA isn't on Accentra?
caNotOnAccentra.a: You can invite them by email. Once they join, they can review what you share with them.

languages.q: Can I use Accentra in Tamil or Hindi?
languages.a: Not yet. Accentra is in English today; Tamil and Hindi are planned.

simpleMode.a: Only the words on screen. Both modes use the same ledger and show the same numbers.

realBooks.q: Can I put my real business books on Accentra today?
realBooks.a: Not yet. Accentra is a product in development. Please use sample data only until it has completed a security review and launched.

mission.title: Why we are building this
mission.body: Small businesses in India already work with Chartered Accountants, but the work happens over WhatsApp, email and phone calls. Documents get lost, questions get repeated, and owners rarely understand their own numbers. Accentra puts the books, the documents and the review conversation in one place, on a ledger an accountant can trust.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This draft explains what information Accentra collects, why, and what control you have over it. We intend to align with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. This draft has not been reviewed by a lawyer and does not claim compliance.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Account details you give us (name, email, phone, role). Business records you enter (transactions, contacts, documents). Messages you send through the contact form. Technical data needed to run the service, such as a one-way hash of your IP address used to prevent abuse — we do not store raw IP addresses from the contact form.

why.title: Why we collect it
why.body: To provide the service you asked for: keeping your books, sharing them with your CA, and replying to your messages. We do not use your financial records for advertising.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.body: Only with Chartered Accountants you connect with, limited to what you choose to share, and only until you revoke access. Service providers that host the application (database, file storage, email) process data on our behalf. We do not sell personal data.

delete.title: How to delete your data
delete.body: You can ask us to delete your account and its data at any time through the contact page. Some records may need to be kept for a limited period where the law requires it.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions or requests, use the contact page and choose the subject "Privacy".

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These draft terms describe how Accentra may be used while it is in development. They have not been reviewed by a lawyer.

demo.title: Demonstration product
demo.body: Accentra is in development. Use sample data only. Do not rely on Accentra for real accounting, tax or compliance decisions.

advice.title: Not professional advice
advice.body: Accentra is a record-keeping and collaboration tool. It does not provide accounting, tax or legal advice and does not file returns. Consult your Chartered Accountant.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Keep your login details private. You are responsible for the information you enter and share.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Your records remain yours. See the privacy policy for how they are handled and how to delete them.
